symptom: `create persistent entity M.Owner (…)` (also Type, Object, quoted or not) passed check and exec; mx check failed it with CE7247 "The name 'Owner' is a reserved word." at the entity.
cause: types.IsPlatformReserved was consulted for attribute names (MDL021), enumeration values, parameters and JSON structure names, never for an entity's own name — the list already held every word.
file: mdl/executor/validate_reserved_entity_names.go (new), wired from ValidateEntity, validate_program.go (view entity, rename), execRenameEntity, execCreateViewEntity
fix: MDL021 now refuses a reserved entity name on create entity (any kind), create view entity and rename entity, in check and in exec (refuseReservedEntityName, so --no-check cannot write it).
insight: Measure the whole list before choosing it: one 11.12.6 script of 22 entities settled that SystemAttributeNames (CreatedDate, ChangedDate, ChangedBy) are reserved as ENTITY names too, on a non-persistent entity as well, while String/User/System/List are not — so IsPlatformReserved is exactly right, and check now names the same 17 mx does. Found in passing while building a control for ako/mxcli#2523.
test: mdl/executor/reserved_entity_name_2531_test.go (create, quoted, non-persistent, audit name, rename; String/User/OwnerRecord controls)
